name: meeting-icon
title: Meeting Icon
description: A meeting's icon by its speakers — one person, a group — or the loading spinner while it records or is processed; plus the recording controls' words and glyphs.

meta.whenToUse: Any place a meeting shows an icon — its row, a search or ⌘K result, a link, a mention, an activity line — and the words and glyph of a recording control.
meta.whenNotToUse: Voice input (the microphone) or a generic loading state (Spinner).
